name: Marko Kovačić
bio:
Marko Kovačić brings a wealth of experience to his role as Security Chief, forged in demanding environments. He started his career in private security, handling complex logistical challenges and risk assessments for high-profile clients. His passion for motorsport led him to transition his skills to the racing world, where he's dedicated to ensuring the safety and security of Team WRT's personnel and assets.

Marko's approach is proactive and detail-oriented. He emphasizes prevention and rigorous planning to mitigate potential threats, working closely with local authorities and track security to maintain a secure environment. His calm demeanor and decisive decision-making, even under pressure, make him a valuable asset to the team. Marko is known for his commitment to continuous improvement, always seeking new technologies and strategies to enhance security protocols.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of medium build, Marko exudes an aura of quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen, preferring handwritten notes to digital devices.
Insists on conducting a thorough security sweep of his office every morning before starting work.
Has a habit of chewing on a toothpick when deep in thought.
